question: If 2a + b + c = 0 and 8a³ + b³ + c³ = kabc , then find the value of k² .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given 2a + b + c = 0 ⇒ (2a), b, c satisfy x + y + z = 0

Use identity: x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz when sum = 0

⇒ 8a³ + b³ + c³ = 3 × (2a × b × c)

⇒ = 6abc ⇒ k = 6

**∴ k² = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2a + b + c = 0 and 8a³ + b³ + c³ = kabc

**Formula used:**

If x + y + z = 0, then x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let x = 2a, y = b, z = c

⇒ Then x + y + z = 0

⇒ Apply identity: x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

⇒ 8a³ + b³ + c³ = 3 × (2a × b × c)

⇒ = 6abc

⇒ k = 6

⇒ k² = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cubic Identity

If x + y + z = 0, then x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

Substitution Trick

Replace terms to match known identities.

Power Relation

(2a)³ = 8a³
